independence: production author must not author or modify these cases

cases.subject: main-authoritative LF format state and visible projection
cases.positive: small_lf opens through the GUI and reports UTF-8, No BOM, LF
cases.attack: visible text remains correct while format state or projection reports a non-LF value

cases.subject: main-authoritative CRLF format state and visible projection
cases.positive: small_crlf opens through the GUI and reports CRLF
cases.attack: CRLF bytes are silently normalized or the projection reports LF

cases.subject: main-authoritative BOM state and visible projection
cases.positive: small_bom opens through the GUI and reports BOM present
cases.attack: BOM is removed, inserted, or projected from renderer re-detection

cases.subject: not_utf8 refusal identity and unchanged boundary
cases.positive: valid UTF-8 opens through the same main boundary
cases.attack: invalid-not-utf8 opens, loses its filename/code, mutates state, or writes disk

cases.subject: unreadable refusal and unchanged boundary
cases.attack: read failure replaces current document or increments boundaryGeneration

cases.subject: unwritable refusal, dirty preservation, and unchanged boundaryGeneration
cases.attack: failed save clears dirty, advances generation, or claims success

cases.subject: main-side path rejection before I/O
cases.positive: a normalized permitted path reaches the intended operation
cases.attack: renderer overrides rejection or I/O occurs before path_rejected

cases.subject: cancelled/refused snapshots preserve main authoritative state
cases.positive: accepted operation advances boundaryGeneration exactly once
cases.attack: cancelled/refused operation changes state, dirty, format, or generation

cases.subject: initial and post-operation DMS labels equal the main BoundarySnapshot
cases.positive: new/open/save snapshots render from getDocumentFormatState and operation results
cases.attack: renderer re-detects format, uses stale state, or invents a second DTO
